panels.title: RPC Request Rate by Command
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*How many times each RPC command runs per second.*

###### How it's computed:
*Per-second rate of command executions over 5 minutes, grouped by command name and node.*

###### Reading it:
*Compare bars/lines across commands to see which endpoints drive load.*

###### Healthy range:
*Workload-dependent; dominated by whichever commands clients call most.*

###### Watch for:
*A single command spiking far above its norm, consistent with a client hammering one endpoint.*

###### Source:
[RPCHandler.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/rpc/detail/RPCHandler.cpp)

###### Function:
`callMethod`

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (command, service_instance_id, xrpl_branch, xrpl_node_role) (rate(span_calls_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", command=~"$command", span_name=~"rpc.command.*"}[$__rate_interval])), "series", "$1", "command", "(.*)")

panels.title: RPC Latency P95 by Command
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*The 95th-percentile response time for each RPC command.*

###### How it's computed:
*95th-percentile of per-command execution durations over 5 minutes, grouped by command and node.*

###### Reading it:
*Lower is better; watch the slowest commands.*

###### Healthy range:
*Fast lookups a few ms; heavy queries tens to hundreds of ms. Workload-dependent.*

###### Watch for:
*A command whose latency climbs steadily, pointing to an expensive or degrading query path.*

###### Source:
[RPCHandler.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/rpc/detail/RPCHandler.cpp)

###### Function:
`callMethod`

targets.expr: label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, command, service_instance_id, xrpl_branch, xrpl_node_role) (rate(span_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", command=~"$command", span_name=~"rpc.command.*"}[5m]))), "series", "P95 $1", "command", "(.*)")

panels.title: RPC Error Rate
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*The percentage of each command's calls that finished with an error.*

###### How it's computed:
*Error calls divided by total calls per command over 5 minutes, expressed as a percent.*

###### Reading it:
*Green under 1%, yellow 1-5%, red above 5%.*

###### Healthy range:
*Below 1% per command in normal operation.*

###### Watch for:
*A command sitting red, indicating malformed input, overload, or a broken handler.*

###### Source:
[RPCHandler.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/rpc/detail/RPCHandler.cpp)

###### Function:
`callMethod`

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (command, service_instance_id, xrpl_branch, xrpl_node_role) (rate(span_calls_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", command=~"$command", span_name=~"rpc.command.*", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (command, service_instance_id, xrpl_branch, xrpl_node_role) (rate(span_calls_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", command=~"$command", span_name=~"rpc.command.*"}[$__rate_interval])) * 100, "series", "$1", "command", "(.*)")

panels.title: RPC Latency Heatmap
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*The full distribution of RPC response times over the window.*

###### How it's computed:
*Counts of requests in each latency band per 5-minute window, shown as color density.*

###### Reading it:
*A tight low band is healthy; multiple bands mean mixed fast/slow requests.*

###### Healthy range:
*Most mass in the low-latency bands; workload-dependent.*

###### Watch for:
*A distinct high-latency cluster (bimodal behavior) that percentiles alone would hide.*

###### Source:
[RPCHandler.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/rpc/detail/RPCHandler.cpp)

###### Function:
`callMethod`

targets.expr: sum(increase(span_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", command=~"$command", span_name=~"rpc.command.*"}[5m])) by (le)

panels.title: Overall RPC Throughput
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*Two layers of the request pipeline: connections accepted by the HTTP handler versus requests parsed and dispatched.*

###### How it's computed:
*Per-second rates of the outer request-accept layer and the inner processing layer over 5 minutes, per node.*

###### Reading it:
*The two lines should track each other closely.*

###### Healthy range:
*Workload-dependent; both lines roughly equal.*

###### Watch for:
*A gap between accept and process, meaning requests are queued or rejected before dispatch.*

###### Source:
[ServerHandler.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/rpc/detail/ServerHandler.cpp)

###### Function:
`ServerHandler::processSession ; ServerHandler::processRequest`

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (service_instance_id, xrpl_branch, xrpl_node_role) (rate(span_calls_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", command=~"$command", span_name="rpc.http_request"}[$__rate_interval])), "series", "rpc.http_request / Sec", "", "")

label_replace(sum by (service_instance_id, xrpl_branch, xrpl_node_role) (rate(span_calls_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", command=~"$command", span_name="rpc.process"}[$__rate_interval])), "series", "rpc.process / Sec", "", "")

panels.title: RPC Success vs Error
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*Aggregate rate of successful versus failed RPC commands across all command types.*

###### How it's computed:
*Per-second rates of ok-status and error-status command completions over 5 minutes, per node.*

###### Reading it:
*Successful commands report an ok status and should dominate; the error line should stay near the floor.*

###### Healthy range:
*Error line near zero relative to success; workload-dependent.*

###### Watch for:
*A sustained error line, which warrants drilling into the per-command breakdown.*

###### Source:
[RPCHandler.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/rpc/detail/RPCHandler.cpp)

###### Function:
`callMethod`

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (service_instance_id, xrpl_branch, xrpl_node_role) (rate(span_calls_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", command=~"$command", span_name=~"rpc.command.*", status_code="STATUS_CODE_OK"}[$__rate_interval])), "series", "Success", "", "")

label_replace(sum by (service_instance_id, xrpl_branch, xrpl_node_role) (rate(span_calls_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", command=~"$command", span_name=~"rpc.command.*", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__rate_interval])), "series", "Error", "", "")

panels.title: Top Commands by Volume
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*The ten most-called RPC commands over the recent window.*

###### How it's computed:
*Total invocation counts per command over the last 5 minutes, ranked and capped at ten.*

###### Reading it:
*The top bars are the hottest endpoints driving node load.*

###### Healthy range:
*Workload-dependent; typically led by lightweight status queries.*

###### Watch for:
*An unexpected command dominating the ranking, consistent with automated abuse.*

###### Source:
[RPCHandler.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/rpc/detail/RPCHandler.cpp)

###### Function:
`callMethod`

targets.expr: label_replace(topk(10, sum by (command, service_instance_id, xrpl_branch, xrpl_node_role) (increase(span_calls_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", command=~"$command", span_name=~"rpc.command.*"}[$__rate_interval]))), "series", "$1", "command", "(.*)")

panels.title: WebSocket Message Rate
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*How many RPC messages arrive over WebSocket connections per second.*

###### How it's computed:
*Per-second rate of processed WebSocket RPC messages over 5 minutes, per node.*

###### Reading it:
*Non-zero only when clients use WebSocket; zero is normal for HTTP-only nodes.*

###### Healthy range:
*Workload-dependent; zero if no WebSocket clients.*

###### Watch for:
*A sudden surge from a single source, consistent with a chatty or abusive subscription client.*

###### Source:
[ServerHandler.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/rpc/detail/ServerHandler.cpp)

###### Function:
`ServerHandler::processSession`

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (service_instance_id, xrpl_branch, xrpl_node_role) (rate(span_calls_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", command=~"$command", span_name="rpc.ws_message"}[$__rate_interval])), "series", "WS Messages / Sec", "", "")

panels.title: RPC Resource Cost by Command
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*RPC traffic grouped by resource-cost category rather than by command name.*

###### How it's computed:
*Per-second rate of commands over 5 minutes, grouped by load/cost category.*

###### Reading it:
*Cheap categories should dominate; costly ones should be a small slice.*

###### Healthy range:
*Workload-dependent; low-cost categories carry most traffic.*

###### Watch for:
*Growth in high-cost categories such as exception or malformed requests, which point to problematic clients.*

###### Source:
[RPCHandler.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/rpc/detail/RPCHandler.cpp)

###### Function:
`callMethod`

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (load_type, xrpl_branch, xrpl_node_role) (rate(span_calls_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", span_name=~"rpc.command.*", load_type!=""}[$__rate_interval])), "series", "$1", "load_type", "(.*)")

panels.title: Batch vs Single RPC Requests
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*The rate of batched RPC requests versus single-command requests.*

###### How it's computed:
*Per-second rates of batch and single requests over 5 minutes, per node.*

###### Reading it:
*Single requests usually dominate; batch is used by bulk clients.*

###### Healthy range:
*Workload-dependent; batch typically a minority.*

###### Watch for:
*A batch rate climbing sharply, consistent with bulk automation or amplification attempts.*

###### Source:
[ServerHandler.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/rpc/detail/ServerHandler.cpp)

###### Function:
`ServerHandler::processRequest`

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (service_instance_id, xrpl_branch, xrpl_node_role) (rate(span_calls_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", span_name="rpc.process", is_batch="true"}[$__rate_interval])), "series", "Batch", "", "")

label_replace(sum by (service_instance_id, xrpl_branch, xrpl_node_role) (rate(span_calls_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", span_name="rpc.process", is_batch="false"}[$__rate_interval])), "series", "Single", "", "")

panels.title: RPC Call Rate (All Methods)
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*Overall rate of RPC method calls that started, finished, and errored, across all methods.*

###### How it's computed:
*Per-second rate of each counter over a 5-minute window, summed per node.*

###### Reading it:
*Started should closely track finished; errored should be a small fraction.*

###### Healthy range:
*Workload-dependent; started ≈ finished, errored near zero.*

###### Watch for:
*A growing gap between started and finished (calls hanging), or an errored line that rises with load.*

###### Source:
[MetricsRegistry.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/telemetry/MetricsRegistry.cpp)

###### Function:
`recordRpcStarted / recordRpcFinished / recordRpcErrored`

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (service_instance_id, xrpl_branch, xrpl_node_role) (rate(rpc_method_started_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])), "series", "Started/s", "", "")

label_replace(sum by (service_instance_id, xrpl_branch, xrpl_node_role) (rate(rpc_method_finished_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])), "series", "Finished/s", "", "")

label_replace(sum by (service_instance_id, xrpl_branch, xrpl_node_role) (rate(rpc_method_errored_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])), "series", "Errored/s", "", "")

panels.title: Per-Method Call Rate (Top 10)
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*The ten busiest RPC methods by call rate.*

###### How it's computed:
*Per-second start rate over 5 minutes, per method, showing the top ten.*

###### Reading it:
*Identifies which methods dominate load; the mix shifts with client behaviour.*

###### Healthy range:
*Workload-dependent.*

###### Watch for:
*A single method suddenly dominating, which can signal a runaway client or abusive query pattern.*

###### Source:
[MetricsRegistry.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/telemetry/MetricsRegistry.cpp)

###### Function:
`recordRpcStarted`

targets.expr: label_replace(topk(10, rate(rpc_method_started_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])), "series", "$1", "method", "(.*)")

panels.title: Per-Method Error Rate (Top 10)
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*The ten RPC methods producing the most errors.*

###### How it's computed:
*Per-second error rate over 5 minutes, per method, top ten.*

###### Reading it:
*Normally near zero; persistent errors point to a specific failing method.*

###### Healthy range:
*Near zero for well-behaved traffic.*

###### Watch for:
*Sustained errors concentrated on one method — a broken client, a bad input, or probing.*

###### Source:
[MetricsRegistry.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/telemetry/MetricsRegistry.cpp)

###### Function:
`recordRpcErrored`

targets.expr: label_replace(topk(10, rate(rpc_method_errored_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])), "series", "$1", "method", "(.*)")

panels.title: RPC Latency - All Methods
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*Aggregate RPC handler latency across all methods (p75 and p99).*

###### How it's computed:
*Percentiles of the method-duration histogram over a 5-minute window.*

###### Reading it:
*p75 reflects typical responsiveness; p99 captures the slow tail.*

###### Healthy range:
*Sub-millisecond to low-millisecond for light commands; heavier commands run longer.*

###### Watch for:
*A rising p99 while p75 stays flat — a subset of calls degrading, often from expensive queries.*

###### Source:
[MetricsRegistry.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/telemetry/MetricsRegistry.cpp)

###### Function:
`recordRpcFinished`

targets.expr: label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.75, sum by (le, service_instance_id, xrpl_branch, xrpl_node_role) (rate(rpc_method_us_bucket{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", method=~"$method"}[5m]))), "series", "p75", "", "")

label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, service_instance_id, xrpl_branch, xrpl_node_role) (rate(rpc_method_us_bucket{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", method=~"$method"}[5m]))), "series", "p99", "", "")

panels.title: Per-Method Latency (p99, Top 10 Slowest)
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*The ten slowest RPC methods by tail latency.*

###### How it's computed:
*p99 of each method's duration histogram over 5 minutes, top ten.*

###### Reading it:
*Surfaces which specific methods are expensive.*

###### Healthy range:
*Method-dependent; ledger/account queries are heavier than status calls.*

###### Watch for:
*A method whose p99 climbs over time, or an unexpectedly cheap method appearing here.*

###### Source:
[MetricsRegistry.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/telemetry/MetricsRegistry.cpp)

###### Function:
`recordRpcFinished`

targets.expr: label_replace(topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, method, service_instance_id, xrpl_branch, xrpl_node_role) (rate(rpc_method_us_bucket{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", method=~"$method"}[5m])))), "series", "$1", "method", "(.*)")

panels.title: RPC Error Ratio by Method
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*The methods with the highest error rates, for spotting failure hotspots.*

###### How it's computed:
*Per-second error rate over 5 minutes, per method, top ten.*

###### Reading it:
*Highlights where failures concentrate.*

###### Healthy range:
*Near zero.*

###### Watch for:
*One method with a persistently high error rate — malformed requests or targeted probing.*

###### Source:
[MetricsRegistry.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/telemetry/MetricsRegistry.cpp)

###### Function:
`recordRpcErrored`

targets.expr: label_replace(topk(10, rate(rpc_method_errored_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval]) / (rate(rpc_method_started_total{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0)), "series", "$1", "method", "(.*)")

panels.title: Current RPC Latency (p99 Gauge)
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*Current tail latency (p99) of RPC handling across all methods, as a live gauge.*

###### How it's computed:
*p99 of the method-duration histogram over the recent window.*

###### Reading it:
*A single at-a-glance number for current RPC responsiveness.*

###### Healthy range:
*Low-millisecond under normal load.*

###### Watch for:
*Sustained elevation, indicating the node is under query pressure.*

###### Source:
[MetricsRegistry.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/telemetry/MetricsRegistry.cpp)

###### Function:
`recordRpcFinished`

targets.expr: label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, xrpl_branch, xrpl_node_role) (rate(rpc_method_us_bucket{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", xrpl_work_item=~"$xrpl_work_item", xrpl_branch=~"$xrpl_branch", xrpl_node_role=~"$xrpl_node_role", method=~"$method"}[5m]))), "series", "p99 Latency", "", "")

title: RPC Performance
description:
What this shows: Per-command and per-method RPC performance: call rates, error rates, and latency distributions.
Use it to: Identify slow or failing RPC commands and track client-facing request latency.
